scenario: A luxury hotel shortlists concierge candidates who exhibit exceptional language proficiency OR outstanding service polish. These two traits are independent in the applicant pool; however, the OR-gate shortlisting creates a spurious negative association among shortlisted candidates.

data.description: Population base rates and OR-gate selection mechanism

values.selection_rule: OR gate: selected if language proficiency OR service polish

question: (a) What is P(selected)? (b) What is P(language_proficiency|not_service_polish, selected)? (c) What is P(language_proficiency|service_polish, selected)? (d) Explain why language proficiency and service polish appear negatively correlated among selected candidates even though they are independent in the population.

ground_truth.explanation: Under OR-gate selection, a candidate lacking service polish must have language proficiency to be selected (P=1.0). A candidate who has service polish is selected regardless of language proficiency, so P(language proficiency | service polish, selected) = P(language proficiency) = 0.45. This differential probability creates a negative within-selected correlation despite population independence.

naive_answer: The negative correlation among selected candidates reflects a genuine inverse relationship between language proficiency and service polish in the domain.
naive_trap: The negative correlation is entirely an artefact of OR-gate collider selection, not a real population-level relationship between the two traits.
reasoning_trace: (1) P(sel)=P(A)+P(B)-P(A)P(B)=0.45+0.55-0.45×0.55=0.7525. (2) If not-B and selected, must have A → P(A|not-B,sel)=1.0. (3) If B and selected, selection is independent of A → P(A|B,sel)=P(A)=0.45. (4) The gap between 1.0 and 0.45 produces a negative association within the selected group via collider bias.
python_verification:
pA,pB = 0.45,0.55
pSel = pA+pB-pA*pB
assert abs(pSel-0.7525)<0.005
pA_notB_sel = pA*(1-pB)/(pA*(1-pB))   # =1.0
assert abs(pA_notB_sel-1.0)<0.005
pA_B_sel = pA*pB/pB                    # =pA
assert abs(pA_B_sel-pA)<0.005
assert pA_notB_sel > pA_B_sel          # negative collider bias confirmed
